children: Amazon forecast ~$220B 2026 capex for AWS and AI. A recent bond sale funded about 2.6% of that planned 2026 spending, showing partial use of debt financing.
Amazon partners with OpenAI to let select U.S. advertisers extend Amazon ad campaigns into ChatGPT; Amazon manages campaigns while OpenAI controls delivery and placements under ChatGPT responses.
Amazon (AMZN) invested ~$40B in Ohio data centers since 2015, created thousands of jobs, paid about $11M in state taxes last year; Ohio officials may renegotiate or repeal data-center tax breaks.
Amazon to extend its benefits to U.S. Whole Foods staff from Jan 1, 2027: health plans from $5/week, $5 primary care copays, free One Medical membership, benefits value +75%.
Amazon added cybersecurity chief Kevin Mandia to its 12-member board. Board-level security committee remains; Mandia’s appointment expands board composition. (AMZN)
Thiel Macro's Q2 2026 13F shows Amazon (AMZN) as its top holding: about $118M, ~28% of assets, tied to AWS data-center expansion and long-term power deals for AI infrastructure.
